oMeni.lead: Faris Zenunović is an SEO specialist from Živinice, Bosnia and Herzegovina, working in technical SEO, content strategy and web development since 2022. He is a co-founder of the digital agency ZT Media and has worked on SEO projects for Finixio and ClickOut Media across the crypto, fintech and igaming sectors.
oMeni.photoAlt: Faris Zenunović, SEO specialist from Živinice, Bosnia and Herzegovina
oMeni.factFocusValue: Technical SEO, content systems, organic growth, Meta Ads
oMeni.bgP1: It started in 2022 with self-taught study - technical audits, on-page optimization, keyword research and content strategy, applied to his own test sites. What stuck from that period is a structured workflow for competitive analysis and SERP evaluation that still sits behind every project.
oMeni.bgP2: Since 2022 he has worked as a freelance SEO specialist for local and regional clients, building sites from scratch in Next.js, React and TypeScript, and in WordPress for lighter requirements. In parallel he ran SEO for a portfolio of affiliate sites in the crypto, fintech and regulated finance space through Finixio, then produced and optimized long-form content for ClickOut Media across crypto and igaming niches.
oMeni.bgP3: In 2026 he co-founded ZT Media, a web and SEO agency serving local and regional businesses in the automotive, manufacturing and retail sectors. He graduated in marketing communications from IPI Academy in Tuzla in 2026.
oMeni.resultsIntro: A few measurable outcomes from recent years:
oMeni.result1: Ranked eko-box.hr to an average Google position of 2 - 2,340 clicks and 34,600 impressions, with no paid links.
oMeni.result2: Auratherm, an outdoor sauna manufacturer: a website with 490 organic clicks in three months, a 14.9% CTR and an average position of 6.
oMeni.result3: esports.net - contributed technical SEO and content restructuring on a site with over 43,000 organic keywords.
oMeni.result4: 99bitcoins.com - SEO content work on a site with a domain authority score of 51 and over 76,000 monthly organic visits.
oMeni.edu1: BA in Marketing Communications - IPI Academy Tuzla, graduated 2026.
oMeni.orgP: ZT Media is a web development and SEO agency co-founded in 2026, working with businesses across Bosnia and Herzegovina and the wider region. Within the agency, Faris Zenunović leads SEO strategy and full website builds for clients.
oMeni.contactP: For collaboration, an SEO audit or any questions - email or LinkedIn is fastest.

usluge.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about SEO services
usluge.faq1Q: How long does SEO take to show results?
usluge.faq1A: You can expect first visible results within 3-6 months. Local SEO often delivers faster results - sometimes within 4-8 weeks. SEO is a long-term investment: unlike paid ads, organic rankings remain even after you stop paying.
usluge.faq2Q: What are SEO services and why are they important?
usluge.faq2A: SEO services are a set of strategies that improve your website's visibility in Google's organic results. They matter because 75% of users never go past the first page of search results, and organic traffic delivers stable, long-term visits without constant advertising costs.
usluge.faq3Q: How does SEO differ from paid ads (Google Ads)?
usluge.faq3A: Google Ads delivers immediate results while you pay. SEO builds lasting authority for your website that works even when you are not paying. The ideal strategy combines both - Ads for short-term goals, SEO for long-term growth.
usluge.faq4Q: Do you do SEO for businesses outside BiH?
usluge.faq4A: Yes. I work with businesses in the region (Serbia, Croatia, Montenegro) and in the global market in English. Contact me for a custom quote.
usluge.auditTitle: Get a free SEO audit of your website
usluge.auditDesc: I analyze your website and send a detailed report with concrete recommendations. Find out where you are losing rankings and what needs to be fixed.
usluge.svc5Desc: Paid campaigns that bring messages, calls and leads from your local market, with creatives made for Reels and clear tracking of what every result costs.
